findings.current: Empieza una con Nuevo, o desde Local Operator en tu máquina
findings.proposed: Empieza una con el botón Nuevo, o desde Local Operator en tu máquina
findings.reason: 'una' is feminine (conversación) while the articleless button name 'Nuevo' is masculine in the same clause; naming the control removes the clash, and the key has no maxCells budget and already wraps to two lines, so 'el botón ' costs no layout.

findings.current: Un envío o Reanudar la reabre en tu carpeta personal
findings.proposed: Enviar un mensaje o Reanudar la reabre en tu carpeta personal
findings.reason: 'Un envío' as a countable noun reads as a shipment; this locale's own relay.asks.sheet.ended_wait phrases the same behaviour with an infinitive ('responder la reabrirá'). 'Reanudar' matches the button and 'carpeta personal' is the settled home-folder rendering, so the ended/history/not-project-folder meaning survives.
Same noun choice as a1-02: the banner is about the messages typed now, which this locale calls 'mensajes' (composer.label). 33 cells against a 36-cell budget.

The definite article is expected in a Spanish back label; the string is also the visible action on the load-failure screen. 26 cells against a 28-cell budget.
Same article omission; the line names one specific conversation. 25 cells against a 28-cell budget.
